title: Shade Network
description: A cool Minecraft server, our vision is to have players of all types on our server as we currently offer an Economy gamemode, where you can buy gear, hunt bounties and become the strongest!
body:
# Shade Network - Economy

Currently we offer you with an Economy survival gamemode where you can sell certain items to make money and buy combat gear using that money. We encourage combat of all types, fight how you like!

Shade Network holds multiple events every month to keep the fun alive, all we need is you!
